title: COMPO: Community Preferences for Language Model Personalization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the preference win-rate of a community-contextualized language model against a generic baseline on political subreddits (e.g., r/Conservative) using GPT-4 and human annotators to see if it overcomes typical liberal-leaning biases of generalist models.

Evaluating the preference win-rate of a community-contextualized language model against a generic baseline on gender-focused subreddits (e.g., r/AskWomen) using GPT-4 and human annotators to assess if it can better reflect less dominant voices and overcome typical male-dominated perspectives.
